boundaries.name: \Gamma_q
boundaries.description: chip heat-flux boundary (central 40% of the bottom edge) with prescribed uniform heat flux q

boundaries.name: \Gamma_c
boundaries.description: cooling edges (top, left, right) exchanging heat by convection and surface radiation with the ambient air

boundaries.name: adiabatic_bottom_edge
boundaries.description: remaining part of the bottom edge, adiabatic (zero heat flux)

constants.name: q
constants.description: heat flux injected by the chip

objective.name: J
objective.description: chip temperature integral (thermal compliance measuring the heat sink thermal resistance) at fixed material cost

state_equation.description: non-linear conduction-convection-radiation state problem for the temperature u
state_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{D} k \chi (\nabla u \cdot \nabla \delta u)\,dx + \int_{\Gamma_c} h\,u\,\delta u\,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_c} \varepsilon\sigma u^{4}\delta u\,ds_x
state_equation.weak_form_rhs: \int_{\Gamma_q} q\,\delta u\,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_c} h\,u_{amb}\,\delta u\,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_c} \varepsilon\sigma u_{amb}^{4}\,\delta u\,ds_x

newton_linearisation.description: Newton update \hat u at the state u, with radiation linearised as \partial_u[\varepsilon\sigma(u^4 - u_{amb}^4)]\hat u = 4\varepsilon\sigma u^3 \hat u

adjoint_equation.description: adjoint problem for the adjoint state \tilde u (self-adjoint linearisation of the state operator at u), with adjoint load from \partial_u J
adjoint_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{D} k \chi (\nabla \delta u \cdot \nabla \tilde u)\,dx + \int_{\Gamma_c} h\,\delta u\,\tilde u\,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_c} 4\varepsilon\sigma u^{3}\delta u\,\tilde u\,ds_x

fields.name: u
fields.rationale: No Dirichlet boundaries in the problem, so dirichlet_labels is empty.

constants.name: q
constants.description: heat flux injected by the chip

expressions.name: k
expressions.rationale: The state weak form uses k \chi; k is the solid thermal conductivity, equal to k_0. Defined as an expression to avoid duplicating the constant.

optimization_config.rationale: Designed optimization configuration: hmin/hmax ~1/100 and ~1/10 of unit domain; diffusion 1e-4; v0 1e-3; 30 iterations; level-set initial signed-distance for a circular hole of radius 0.1 at center; boundary_labels from extracted design_role (Robin label 3); fixed_labels from extracted design_role (labels 1 and 2); mesh_file from extracted spec.
